source.name: Al Shamal SC (Instagram): 2026/27 kit launch post
source.quote: This is the Al Shamal jersey for the 2026/27 season.
source.note: Kit maker. adidas mark on the chest, visible in the club's own launch photos; the shirt carries no commercial sponsor logos on the front, sleeves or shorts.

summary: adidas home kit (red) with no commercial shirt sponsors: the front carries only the adidas mark and club crest, and the sleeves and shorts show no sponsor logos, as seen in the club's kit-launch post and in official QSL photography of the Week 3 and Week 4 home matches (September 2026). The shirt's back has not been photographed from a verifiable angle, so the sponsor list is not marked complete.
